messages:
Maria (CS): Heads up — Gamma (reserved dedicated pool) reported a sudden drop in rerank precision after yesterday's model variant rollout. They say top-1 results are often irrelevant now. Ticket #CS-9241: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-9241
Alex (Support): Thanks Maria. Can you paste a minimal repro (query + expected vs actual) and their config?
Maria (CS): Pasted repro below. They're using model: rw-instruct-v2-q4_0 (quantized), embed model: rw-embed-512. Seq len ~ 512; batching enabled.
```
query: "how to reset 2fa on enterprise portal"
expected rerank top3: [doc-42, doc-7, doc-103]
actual rerank top3:   [doc-7, doc-103, doc-99]
customer config:
  rerank_threshold: 0.75
  embed_model: rw-embed-512
  rerank_model: rw-instruct-v2-q4_0
  dedupe: true
```
Maria (CS): They say this started ~2026-03-14T10:03:00Z right after we switched their pool to the q4_0 variant for cost reasons.
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "model switch completed for org gamma at 2026-03-14T10:01:42Z — rw-instruct-v2 -> rw-instruct-v2-q4_0 (quantized)"
Alex (Support): Got it. Asking Gamma if they can tolerate a rollback. Also collecting logs.
Jing (Eng): Quick thoughts: quantization can change embedding distribution slightly; rerank is sensitive. Need sample embeddings + cosine deltas pre/post. Maria — do you have previous outputs or a saved cache?
Maria (CS): They do. Attached in the ticket. I'll upload short sample of 50 queries and corresponding embedding vectors.
Sam (Product): Looping in product triage. What's customer impact/severity?
Maria (CS): Impact high for search UX on their help docs — several tickets from power users. Gamma requests either rollback or a fix within 72h. They're on a committed contract; SLA applies.
Sam (Product): Priority = P1 for product backlog intake. Proposed immediate actions: 1) temporary rollback for Gamma's dedicated pool, 2) open engineering investigation to compare embed distributions and rerank loss function sensitivity, 3) evaluate longer-term mitigation (calibration layer or fallback routing).
Jing (Eng): Agreed. For investigation I need: a) pre/post embedding vectors (n=50), b) sample tokenization/seq stats, c) batch size and KV cache config at time of switch. If we can reproduce locally, we'll run ablation (quant params).
Alex (Support): Gamma can accept rollback for 48h. I'll file ops request.
Sam (Product): Ok assign owners: Jing -> root cause + short-term fix analysis, Alex -> coordinate rollback with eng-oncall/ops, Maria -> customer comms and verify acceptance criteria. Product will create a backlog ticket with acceptance criteria and rollout gating.
Jing (Eng): Quick note — if it's distribution shift from quant, a targeted retrain/FP16 fallback for reranker might be needed. Also check dynamic batching effect: continuous batching may alter prompt lengths passed to reranker stack.
Maria (CS): Customer wants explicit acceptance criteria: "post-rollback results match historical top3 in 90% of sampled queries". They want communication within 3 hours.
Sam (Product): I'll create a product ticket PRD-lite: short description, impact, metrics (Top-1 precision delta, MRR change), rollback plan, owner, timeline. Linking here when done.
Alex (Support): Eng-oncall scheduled rollback at 2026-03-14T13:30Z. ops-bot to confirm when done.
ops-bot: "rollback started for gamma-pool at 2026-03-14T13:31:05Z, target model: rw-instruct-v2"
Jing (Eng): I'll start reproducing locally with their sample set. If we can reproduce, we'll propose either quant param tweak or a small calibration layer between embeddings and reranker.
Sam (Product): Acceptance criteria for backlog story: 1) Root cause identified and documented, 2) Fix validated on sample set (>=90% top1 match), 3) No >2% latency regression, 4) Rollout plan to other customers.
Maria (CS): Customer acked rollback window and appreciates fast response. I'll keep them updated.
Alex (Support): ops-bot: rollback complete at 2026-03-14T13:38:20Z.
ops-bot: "rollback complete for gamma-pool — rw-instruct-v2 restored"
Maria (CS): Quick verification from Gamma: early checks look good, top3 restored for 42/50 sample queries. They're running extended checks, will update in ticket.
Sam (Product): I'll add backlog item and tag P1. Jing, please add any reproduction notes to the ticket when you have them.
Jing (Eng): Will do. First pass shows mean cosine similarity dropped ~0.03 after quant; that's likely enough to flip some ranks. More data incoming.
Maria (CS): Closing loop — customer happy with rollback for now, wants longer-term fix. Leaving ticket open for product/eng to own.
Sam (Product): Thanks team. We'll keep this in the product backlog and schedule an engineering spike.
Alex (Support): Marking this thread as triaged.
Maria (CS): :thumbsup:
